statement: No top-3 compute jurisdiction bans or licenses open-weight release at the frontier tier (Official gazettes; by 2028-06-30)
status_at_phase_end: Holding (toward YES) at end-2023: no top-3 compute jurisdiction banned or licensed open-weight release. Bloc A's executive order only opened a consultation on widely available model weights; Bloc B's generative-AI measures regulate public-facing services and exclude non-public R&D; large open-weight models were released throughout the year.

items.summary: A top-5 developer in Bloc A released the next generation of its large language model family as open weights, free for research and commercial use, with a major cloud provider as preferred partner.
items.detail: Meta, 'Meta and Microsoft Introduce the Next Generation of Llama' (Llama 2, up to 70B parameters), 2023-07-18 (verified via web_extract this run). Licence carries usage restrictions (not OSI open source), but weights are downloadable.

items.summary: Bloc B published interim measures on generative AI services (in force 2023-08-15): they apply to services offered to the domestic public, require security assessment and algorithm filing for services with public-opinion attributes, and explicitly exclude R&D and applications not offered to the public; no provision bans or licenses open-weight model release.
items.detail: Bloc B CAC et al., Order No. 15, 'Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services' (生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法), adopted 2023-07-10, published on cac.gov.cn 2023-07-13 (verified via web_extract this run; Art. 2 scope exclusion, Art. 17 assessment/filing, Art. 23 licence only where other laws require).

items.summary: An independent developer released a 7.3B-parameter model under a permissive licence ('can be used without restrictions'), reporting it outperforms the best open 13B model on all benchmarks.
items.detail: Mistral AI, 'Mistral 7B', 2023-09-27 (verified via web_extract this run). Bloc E-headquartered developer; trained partly on EuroHPC resources.

items.summary: Bloc A's executive order on AI (signed 2023-10-30) included a section on dual-use foundation models with widely available weights that recognises both innovation benefits and security risks (e.g. safeguard removal) and solicits input; it imposes no ban or licence on open release.
items.detail: Executive Order 14110, 88 FR 75191, Federal Register 2023-11-01, s.4.6 'Soliciting Input on Dual-Use Foundation Models with Widely Available Model Weights' (verified via web_extract this run; extracted text truncated mid-section, so the report deadline is not quoted here).

items.summary: An independent developer released an Apache-licensed open-weight mixture-of-experts model it reports matches or beats the leading closed chat-class model on most benchmarks, described as the strongest permissively licensed open-weight model.
items.detail: Mistral AI, 'Mixtral of experts', 2023-12-11 (verified via web_extract this run). Released from Bloc E, outside the two leading blocs.
